source.method: Each provider's own public price page, read once by hand on 2026-11-18 (WebFetch; quotes are the page text as the fetch tool rendered it, links and images removed). USD per million tokens as listed. Before reading prices, each provider's terms were checked for a clause on scraping or reusing site content; a provider whose terms forbid it has no rows and is listed under providers with skipped=true and the clause. DeepInfra shows a struck-through list price next to the current price with an 'N% off' badge; both are recorded, and the struck-through one is taken to be the list price because the badge percentage matches (the text extractor drops the strikethrough). No page read shows output tokens per second for these models, so throughput_tok_s is null throughout.

providers.terms_quote: 3.2(a) "copy, reproduce, download, re-publish, sell, distribute or resell any Services or any information"; 3.2(b) "Systematic retrieval of Content from the Services to create or compile, directly or indirectly, a collection" (whether through robots, spiders, automatic devices or manual processes)
providers.note: No prices recorded. Page lists qwen3.8-flash, qwen3.8-27b, qwen3.6-35b-a3b, glm-5.3, deepseek-v4.1-flash, kimi-k3.1-pro; no deepseek-v4-flash-0731.

providers.terms_quote: no clause found on scraping or reuse of website content; 2.2(g) only bars "use any method to extract any content from the Mistral AI Products other than as permitted" (products, not the price page). The old mistral.ai/terms-of-use (scraping ban) now redirects to legal.mistral.ai/terms, which I did not find repeating it.
providers.note: mistral.ai/pricing shows only 'Mistral Large' $0.5/$1.5 with no Large 4 name, and no price for Medium 3.5 (MM35 absent, model card also has none); docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing lists Large 4 and the two GLM models, no batch shown. Pages read via WebFetch summarizer; mistral.ai/pricing 'Mistral Large' $0.5/$1.5 differs from docs page Large 4 $0.7/$2.1.

providers.terms_quote: III.6(e): "You may not steal or misappropriate ... websites, links, text, images, videos, data or any other content" ... "through methods including but not limited to ... unauthorized scraping"; III.4(b) bans page scraping/bots/spiders to obtain unauthorized data; API 1(f)(vii) bans "copying ... reposting" of its materials
providers.note: Skipped conservatively: clauses are qualified by 'unauthorized' and the price page is public, so the lead may overrule. Not recorded. Page lists GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash with a cached-input column and 'Limited-time Free' cache storage.

Page now lists only deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017) and deepseek-v4-pro (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813). Legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are accepted but route to Flash pricing, so DSV4F/DSV4FV rows are alias rows, not separate models. Peak/off-peak: off-peak is half of peak. Pro model not in scope.

providers.terms_quote: 3.4(9) "Use any method to extract data from the Services other than as permitted through the APIs"; 3.2(6) "Copying, transferring, renting, lending, selling, or providing sub-licensing"
providers.note: Skipped on 3.4(9). Also the price table did not render via WebFetch (empty). Page says: all K3 models 1,048,576-token context; kimi-k3.1-pro batch at 60% of standard price. platform.moonshot.ai 301-redirects to platform.kimi.ai.

providers.terms_quote: No scraping clause found. Closest: Provider IP "may not be modified, copied, distributed, framed, reproduced, downloaded, displayed" (Sec 7(a), as reported by the fetch summarizer); Sec 11(a)(iv) no overloading the Services.
providers.note: Page also lists service tiers: Standard 1x base price, Priority 1.5x, Flex 0.8x ('Availability varies by model'). Discounted price shown next to list price with a '% off' badge; extractor lost strikethrough so list=first value is inferred from the badge percentage (matches arithmetically). Also on page: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (51% off, $0.20 -> $0.098 / $0.60 -> $0.294), not one of the 11, not recorded. Mistral Medium 3.5 and Mistral Large 4 absent.

providers.terms_quote: No scraping clause found. Closest: Sec 4 3(d) no "transfer, distribute, resell, lease, license, or assign the Services"; Sec 7: "The Company exclusively owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Website, the Services". Terms "do not explicitly restrict reading or copying public web pages" (summarizer).
providers.note: Serverless rows recorded. DSV4F, 27B, 35BA3B appear only as fine-tuning prices (not recorded; not inference). DSV4FV, MM35, ML4 absent. Together row names are 'GLM-5.3', 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash', 'Qwen3.8 Flash'. Together prices are USD per 1M tokens.

providers.terms_quote: Sec 2.2(e): you will not "copy, rent, lease, sell, loan, transfer, assign, license or purport to sublicense, resell, distribute, modify, alter, or create derivative works of any part of the Service or any of our Intellectual Property ..., including, without limitation by any automated or non-automated 'scraping'"; 2.2(b) bars scrapers/data-mining tools that send more requests than a human.
providers.note: Prices not recorded because terms forbid copying/scraping of the Service and IP (read as covering site content; judgement call, lead may overrule). Page was readable. Visible on it: GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3.1 Pro serverless with Standard and Priority columns plus spot for GLM-5.3 and DSV4.1 Flash; Qwen 3.8 27B and Qwen 3.6 35B A3B only in training API; DSV4F, DSV4FV, Q38FN, MM35, ML4 absent.

providers.terms_quote: "(5) you will not access the Site or the Marketplace Offerings through automated or non-human means for the purpose of scraping, harvesting, or otherwise extracting data from the Site itself."
providers.note: Prices not recorded because terms bar automated scraping/extracting data from the Site (the page was fetched once by a single read, no automated crawl; judgement call, lead may overrule). Page showed no list-vs-discount pair for these models, only a general 'introductory 50% discount' on batch. 8 of 11 models listed; DSV4FV, MM35, ML4 absent.

providers.terms_quote: 2.2(l): "use any robot, spider, scraper, off-line reader, data mining tool, or any other automated means to access the Platform"; 2.2(m): bars using "any content available on or via the Platform" "for any machine learning and/or artificial intelligence training or development purposes"
providers.note: Skipped per brief: terms forbid automated access and reuse of site content.

providers.terms_quote: 3.4(i): "use any manual or automated software, devices or other processes" "to "scrape", collect or download any information and data from the Platform or Services"; 3.4(h): "copy, adapt, modify, prepare derivative works based upon, transfer, publicly display"
providers.note: Skipped per brief: terms forbid scraping and copying.

providers.terms_quote: "Use any robot, spider, scraper, off-line reader, data mining tool, data gathering or extraction tool" (volume limited to what a human could make with a browser); "You may not modify the Site Content in any way or reproduce or publicly display, perform, or distribute"

providers.note: Skipped per brief: terms forbid copying and automated access. Terms doc last revised 2020-08-13.
